description_en: Calls ListPolicies to query a list of access policies
description_zh: 调用ListPolicies查看权限策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager list-policies --policy-type Custom --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPolicies

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access policy. If this parameter is left empty, all types of access policies are listed. 

Custom: custom policy.
System: system policy
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略类型。取值为空表示列出所有类型的权限策略。 

Custom：自定义策略。
System：系统策略
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The language type. The description of the system access policy is returned in the specified language.

en: English.
zh-CN: Chinese.
ja: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型。系统权限策略的描述将以此语言返回。

en：英文。
zh-CN：中文。
ja：日文
parameters.name: language

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页时每页显示的数据行数

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of references to the access policy

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the access policy was created. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, indicated by Z
CreateDate.description_zh: 权限策略创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

DefaultVersion.description_en: The default version of the access policy

Description.description_en: The description of the access policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the access policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the access policy.

Custom: custom policy.
System: system policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
权限策略类型。

Custom：自定义策略。
System：系统策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the access policy was last updated. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, indicated by Z
UpdateDate.description_zh: 权限策略更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC
